objective: Expose authenticated rebuildable owner views with evidence and freshness.
deliverable_refs: Bounded pagination, stable sort, projection sequence/lag and redacted errors.
Minimal public liveness and private detailed diagnostics.
required_test_refs: Unauthenticated/object-ID guessing cannot read sensitive state.
Projection rebuild matches source receipts; stale data remains labeled.
Large exports and invalid pagination are bounded.
acceptance_gate: All owner views are permissioned projections with traceable canonical sources.
